title: MealogMealImport
description: Schema for importing a meal into the Mealog catalog. Do NOT include id, createdAt, updatedAt, or householdId.

name.description: Unique meal name. Title-case. Max 60 characters.

description.description: 1–2 sentence description of the dish. No markdown.
examples: Herb-crusted salmon fillet served with roasted asparagus and cherry tomatoes.

image.description: Meal photo. Use Unsplash URLs for seed/import meals.

content.description: Unsplash URL with ?w=400 suffix, or base64 data URI for uploads.

recipe.description: Recipe instructions — either a URL or inline text steps.

type.description: 'text' for inline instructions, 'url' for external link.

content.description: URL string or plain-text cooking instructions (1–4 sentences).
examples: Season salmon with herbs. Roast at 400°F for 12-15 minutes. Toss vegetables in olive oil and roast 20 minutes.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients. Quantities are for the WHOLE RECIPE (all servings combined).

quantity.description: Total quantity for the whole recipe (NOT per serving).

unit.$comment: g=grams, kg=kilograms, ml=millilitres, l=litres, pcs=pieces, tbsp=tablespoon, tsp=teaspoon, cup=cup

category.description: Ingredient category for shopping list grouping.
category.$comment: produce=fruit/veg/herbs, meat=meat/fish/poultry, dairy=milk/cheese/eggs/butter, grains=rice/pasta/bread/oats, spices=dry spices/herbs, other=oils/sauces/canned goods/nut butters

nutrition.description: Nutritional information PER SERVING. Cross-reference with USDA FoodData Central (fdc.nal.usda.gov).

calories.description: Kilocalories per serving. Round to nearest 5.

carbs.description: Grams of total carbohydrates per serving.

fat.description: Grams of total fat per serving.

fiber.description: Grams of dietary fiber per serving. (optional)

vitaminC.description: Vitamin C as % of daily value (DV = 90mg). (optional)

vitaminD.description: Vitamin D as % of daily value (DV = 20mcg). (optional)

labels.description: Dietary and lifestyle tags. Use an empty array [] if none apply.

servings.description: Number of servings the recipe yields. Must be at least 2.

examples.name: Lemon Herb Chicken
examples.description: Pan-seared chicken breast with lemon, garlic, and fresh herbs.

recipe.content: Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic, and herbs. Sear in olive oil 6 min per side. Deglaze with lemon juice.
